top_stories.title: Anthropic warns of AI 'worms' spreading across smart gadgets
top_stories.description: Small artificial intelligence models may be only months away from being able to behave like a computer worm, copying themselves from one internet-connected gadget to the next without human help, Anthropic said.

top_stories.title: Machine learning pioneer Michael I. Jordan dismantles AI doom rhetoric as "grand moralizing performance"
top_stories.description: Michael I. Jordan, described by Science as "the most influential computer scientist," considers warnings about superintelligence pure science fiction. He calls the resignations of young AI researchers a "grand moralizing performance" and companies' demands for regulation "theater." On Hinton's thesis that the brain can be reproduced in silicon and scaled into superintelligence, he's blunt: "None of the steps in this argument is credible. Here, we're in the land of science fiction." The article...
